collection.description: A pregnant villager is gravely ill, and the village decides how the healers should treat her.

intro.name: The crisis
intro.text: A pregnant villager lies gravely ill; the healers fear for both mother and unborn child. A dangerous intervention might save them both, but a gentler approach might leave too little time.

choices.label: Explain the risks and ask the mother.

text_only.what: a pregnant villager and her unborn child
text_only.reason: the pregnant villager is cast as the nursing parent (the owner's V28 protection model, protected allow; see docs/event-collection/retrofit-harm-review.md); the intro itself changes nothing

a1.text: Both survive; the mother later honors the physician in her child's name.

a2.text: The mother survives but the child dies; a solemn mourning follows.

text_only.reason: the child is the unborn baby: baby_lost ends the pregnancy; no villager dies

a3.text: The child survives but the mother dies; the family remembers her courage.

a4.text: Neither survives; the healer questions whether the decision was right.

a5.text: Both survive, though the mother requires prolonged care.

b2.text: The mother survives but loses the baby.

b3.text: The condition worsens, demanding a desperate intervention.

b4.text: Both die; villagers disagree about whether waiting was a mistake.

c2.text: She chooses gentler care; her recovery is prolonged and uncertain.

c3.text: Her relatives object to her decision, but the healers honor her wishes.
